newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel business heads hold emergency meeting.
newsitem.headline: Israel business heads hold emergency meeting.

text.p: The leaders of Israel's business organisations met in a special meeting to discuss the situation of the economy, the Manufacturers Association said in a statement.
At the meeting the leaders of industry, chambers of commerce, diamond industry and hotelier and builders organisations expressed concern about the crisis affecting the various economic sectors.
They underlined their concern about the high interest rates, the crisis in the capital markets, the high shekel and the growing problem of foreign workers in Israel.
The business heads are soon to meet with government officials to discuss the problems, the statement said.
